title: Premium Command Center
subtitle: Advanced planning, simulation, organisation and automation tools built from information your club already owns.
premiumOnlyBody: Free managers keep the complete game and manual control. Premium adds deeper analysis, simulations, saved workflows and smart prefills without improving race-engine strength.
scopeBody: Staff Briefing Centre is the coin-based, staff-role advisory system: selected employees proactively interpret training, health, race programme, equipment or scouting. Premium Command Center does not replace those advisors. It provides deterministic dashboards, simulations, scenario tools, templates and user-controlled automation that do not depend on staff skills and do not send advisor reports.
